heroSummary: Minneapolis Public Schools grades 1–12 start Tuesday, September 7, 2027. Pre-K and kindergarten start Thursday, September 9. Grades 10–12 should check with their school for a later start time on the first day during ninth-grade orientation. MEA Break is October 21–22, Winter Break is December 22–January 3, Spring Break is April 3–7, and the last day of school is June 9, 2028.
calendarNotes: Grades 1–12 start September 7, while Pre-K and kindergarten start September 9. Grades 10–12 should check with their school for a later start time on the first day during ninth-grade orientation. The official calendar lists 168 instructional days. October 20 is a family-teacher conference day, followed by MEA Break on October 21–22. Yom Kippur and Eid al-Adha are no-school days for religious observances in 2027–28. Record-keeping and professional-development dates are additional non-school days for students. MPS publishes the calendar in English, Spanish, Somali, and Hmong; bell times vary by campus, so families should check the official MPS table closer to the start of school.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2026–27
content: The first-day dates move from September 8 to September 7 for grades 1–12 and from September 10 to September 9 for Pre-K and kindergarten.
The fall conference/MEA sequence shifts from October 14–16 to October 20–22.
Winter Break starts December 22 instead of December 21 and runs through January 3 instead of January 1.
Spring Break is April 3–7 instead of April 5–9.
The no-school days for religious observances change from Yom Kippur and Eid al-Fitr to Yom Kippur and Eid al-Adha.
The last day moves from June 11 to June 9.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Minneapolis Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 start Tuesday, September 7, 2027. Pre-K and kindergarten start Thursday, September 9. Grades 10–12 should check their high school for a possible later start time on the first day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MPS MEA Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: MEA Break is October 21–22, 2027. The family-teacher conference day immediately before it, October 20, is also a non-school day.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the MPS 2027–28 school year?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Minneapolis Public Schools student calendar lists 168 instructional days. The June 26–July 27 summer-school window is separate from the regular school year.

calendarFaqs.q: Which religious observances are non-school days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists Yom Kippur on October 11, 2027, and Eid al-Adha on May 5, 2028, as non-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find my MPS school’s start and dismissal time?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the School Start and End Times table on the official MPS calendar page. Bell times vary by campus, so check the table again closer to the start of the 2027–28 school year.

First days by grade and the grades 10–12 later start-time note were transcribed separately.
The MPS calendar hub provides the campus bell-time table and the School Board’s religious-observance policy.
The June 26–July 27 summer-school window is outside the 168-day regular school year.
The three translated links point to official MPS-hosted PDFs.
